resolutions.researcher_notes: Old ref (petro-news.com/95212/) is a dead-linking generic Egypt gas-map article and did not verify. This pipeline carries production from the offshore Denise/Karawan fields (Temsah Concession, East Nile Delta, operated by Petrobel JV) to the onshore El Gamil Gas Plant. offshore-technology.com (industry trade press, independently written, not a verbatim BP wire reprint) confirms first gas flowed via the Denise South-6 well starting production in Aug 2014 (1.8 MMcm/d + ~800 bbl/d condensate, ramping to 6.5 MMcm/d by Q1 2015). egyptoil-gas.com's DEKA feature independently corroborates the same startup with its own project-schedule detail (approx. 210 MMscfd target, $470MM cost, sealines to existing 32in network). Status has clearly persisted as 'operating' since 2014 with no indication of shut-in; no source suggests otherwise. Two independent, non-wire trade-press sources -> high tier. (A third source, euro-petrole.com, republishes the original BP press release verbatim and was excluded as non-independent per the wire-reprint rule.)

Al-Mal (جريدة المال), an established Egyptian financial daily, ran a 2012-11-10 piece on Petrobel's Denise/Karawan development (with Eni, Technomare, Enppi as engineering contractors) that gives the exact subsea pipeline schedule for the Denise project: 'خطوط أنابيب بحرية بطول 3.7 كم و405 كم و1كم وبأقطار 16 بوصة و16 بوصة و10 بوصات' -- i.e. three sealines of 3.7km/16in, 405km/16in, and 1km/10in carrying well production to new manifolds. The 405km/16in line matches the GEM LengthKnown=405.00km and Diameter=16in exactly. This was also the source gem.wiki's own citation [3] relied on for this figure, but the sheet's Length [ref] cell was blank -- adding it now. Could not find a second independent source repeating the 405km figure specifically (broader DEKA coverage discusses field distances/rates, not this sealine length), so classed medium (single strong, dated, on-topic trade-press source, no contradicting figure found elsewhere).

Only StartCountryOrArea/EndCountryOrArea=Egypt are populated (no specific start/end place names on this row), so the ref just needs to support 'Egypt' at both ends -- i.e. no cross-border segment. Both sources place the entire Denise/Karawan (DEKA) pipeline system within Egypt: offshore in the Temsah Concession/East Nile Delta (Mediterranean, ~60-70km off the Egyptian coast near Port Said) running to the onshore El Gamil Gas Plant, also in Egypt. No source suggests any non-Egyptian terminus. Reused the two already-verified DEKA trade-press sources rather than searching for a distinct location-specific source, since they directly establish the Egypt-only geography.
